themes.name: Agentic AI research
themes.description: Articles discussing AI agents performing research tasks autonomously or semi-autonomously, including their capabilities, limitations, and deployment.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Focuses on AI tools that assist developers in writing, reviewing, and debugging code.

themes.name: AI chatbot research
themes.description: Covers research and findings related to the behavior, reliability, biases, and user interactions with AI chatbots.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Highlights AI-powered tools and platforms used by researchers for various stages of the research process.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Articles detailing the use of AI to condense and extract key information from text or other data sources.

themes.name: AI design research
themes.description: Explores how AI is integrated into the design process, from ideation to UI/UX development and research.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Discusses the creation and use of artificial user personas or data for testing and research purposes.

themes.name: AI product research
themes.description: Focuses on how AI is applied to understand market needs, develop new products, and analyze product performance.

themes.name: AI recruitment research
themes.description: Examines the impact of AI on job creation, displacement, and the hiring process.

themes.name: AI research tools comparison
themes.description: Articles that compare the performance, features, and effectiveness of different AI tools for research tasks.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
